proves.claim: A gate job settled red only in a case main also fails, one settled stale because a newer gate job exists, and one whose receipt names infrastructure each append one gate_settled event with the outcome and class (red, main-red), (stale, stale-base) and (unknown, infra).

api.io-gate.settled-class-main-red-stale.why: Without this test the timeline reader cannot tell a main-owned red, a stale gate or an infrastructure failure from the item's own red, and charges their wait to the builder.
